about: Rows to merge into assets/audio/sound-index.json in Phase 0 (the four rows); BGM-085 is retired and its file deleted in PR 2b, when bedFor stops returning it. Schema @2 adds optional bgm fields: pool (string), rate (number, default 1), loopStart and loopEnd (seconds; the engine loops the file between them because the generated beds fade to silence at their edges). Loop points were measured 2026-10-14 at 0.1 s resolution with a 20%-of-median RMS threshold; tune by ear in UAT. bgm_game_main_a is bgm_game_aether_voyage byte for byte under its pool name. The engine must start each source at loopStart (source.start(0, loopStart)): a BufferSource otherwise begins at 0 and loopStart only governs where the loop restarts.
